title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-enhancements
description: Context: This PR implements several reliability and observability improvements to the Unified Rollouts subsystem to make canary/A-B/shadow deployments safer and easier to operate. Motivation: Customers running progressive model rollouts reported intermittent false positives from metric-driven auto-rollback (alerts triggered by short-lived skews), lack of visibility into shadow probing results, and limited knobs for quarantine/quorum behavior. This change set addresses those gaps by adding multi-window metric smoothing, quorum-based quarantine for probing stages, richer telemetry for shadow traffic, and stability guards to reduce flapping.
author: Maya Chen
commits: add: multi-window metric smoothing for rollback evaluator (smoothed_average)
feat: add quorum-based quarantine stage and config knobs (quorum_threshold, min_consecutive_failures)
chore: emit shadow-probing telemetry (shadow.probe.* metrics, sample traces)
test: e2e stability guards and new autorollback unit tests

release_notes: Enhancements to Unified Rollouts: metric smoothing windows for rollback evaluator; quorum-based quarantine for probing stages; improved shadow probing telemetry and logs; stability guards to reduce rollback flapping. Admins can tune smoothing windows, quorum_threshold, and min_consecutive_failures via helm/rollouts-values.yaml.
